nodes.summary: Creates the Supabase client with persisted PKCE authentication sessions and implements owner-filtered JSON ledger loading and revision-checked writes with mutation-ID reconciliation.

nodes.name: LedgerStore
nodes.summary: Creates the Supabase client with persisted PKCE authentication sessions and implements owner-filtered JSON ledger loading and revision-checked writes with mutation-ID reconciliation.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.constructor
nodes.summary: Stores the Supabase client and owner ID with initial expected revision zero.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.load
nodes.summary: Reads only the selected owner row and validates its ledger; intentionally leaves expected revision adoption to the UI.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.save
nodes.summary: Increments the expected revision, validates the snapshot, inserts/compares revision atomically, and reconciles uncertain completion by a unique mutation ID.

nodes.name: 20261020163028_cloud_ledger.sql
nodes.summary: Defines one JSONB ledger per authenticated owner, payload validation, owner-only non-anonymous RLS policies, limited grants, revision/mutation triggers, and update timestamps.

nodes.name: public.service_ledgers
nodes.summary: One row per auth owner: owner_id UUID primary key, revision bigint, validated ledger data JSONB, last_mutation UUID, updated_at timestamp. RLS and grants permit authenticated non-anonymous owners to select/insert/update only their row.

nodes.name: public.valid_service_ledger

nodes.name: public.guard_service_ledger_revision
nodes.summary: Enforces insert revision one, immutable owner, revision increment, changed mutation ID, and update timestamp.

tour.title: Purpose and operating scope
tour.description: Read the user guide and product boundaries first. This application records received school-service payments and monthly charges; it does not move money or calculate profit.

tour.title: Boot and screen state
tour.description: Follow the static shell into the browser entry. Account changes reset local in-memory ledger state before the owner-scoped refresh.

tour.title: Money and record invariants
tour.description: Read the pure domain model before editing forms. Integer centavos, globally unique IDs, reference integrity, and one charge per student/month underpin all totals.

tour.title: Safe writes across devices
tour.description: Study LedgerStore and the UI refresh/commit gates together. Expected revisions reject stale saves, while unique mutation IDs help reconcile lost responses.

tour.title: Owner database boundary
tour.description: Inspect the migration source without executing it. Owner RLS, non-anonymous checks, JSONB validation, and revision triggers complement browser checks.

tour.title: Forms and corrections
tour.description: Return to app.js for student, charge, partial payment, archive, and void flows. Historical records are retained; confirmations and failed-draft retention matter.

tour.title: Exports and recovery
tour.description: Inspect CSV/JSON backup generation and explicit ledger replacement. A JSON restore overwrites the account snapshot; it is not a merge between devices.

tour.title: Static delivery
tour.description: Read the bundler, allowlisted loopback server, and hosting headers. The local server exposes built frontend files, not a custom ledger API.

tour.title: Tests and remaining evidence
tour.description: Compare model/cloud mock tests with server and database checks. Test source coverage is not a live Supabase or current browser verification result.
